first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The upright figure entering the distant view from the left edge, wearing lighter clothing on the upper body and darker clothing on the lower body, and visibly blurred overall.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The figure leaning backward in the foreground, with short black hair and narrow dark glasses, wearing an open black long coat, a dark top, and black pants.

entities.name: glass-curtain-wall high-rise
entities.identification: The blue-gray high-rise facade in the background, with broad light-colored vertical structural elements and horizontal and vertical divisions.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: The gray, flat rooftop surface below Person B.

entities.name: low rooftop wall
entities.identification: The low light gray-beige wall section along the rear edge of the rooftop.

entities.name: distant city buildings
entities.identification: The distant cluster of light gray-brown high-rises, some with horizontal floor bands.

entities.name: projectile
entities.identification: The small dark projectile silhouette in the upper-left portion of frame 0, and the reflective projectile near Person B's head and shoulders and close to the viewpoint later in the clip.

entities.name: translucent ring-shaped disturbance
entities.identification: The repeated rows of translucent ring-shaped ripples and the distortion of the background image near them.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The bright light gray-blue sky between the buildings and beside the building masses.
